checks.summary: 78 passed across 7 directly related suites. Four new production-hook REDs on b949 became green: after background DOM has caught up, standard focus, visibility-only, visibility-before-focus and focus-before-visibility return events must permit the next genuinely new append without any intervening React commit or same-text render. Before the fix all four exposed the new suffix at alpha 1 instead of pending alpha 0. Explicit-focus older tests now also directly append, with the artificial same-text return render removed. A new guard case verifies repeated foreground focus/visibility and unrelated workspace events do not change an active frontier. Existing missing-event conservative baseline, background-render-pause, session reentry, final promotion, reasoning and reading cases continue passing. output/assistant-reveal-event-resume-1023/focused.json.

Actual full frontend patch entry completes twice through in-memory write overlay: 30 virtual assets, protected reply/listener regions stable, guards and syntax valid, zero installed dependency writes. Complete asset byte equality remains false from unrelated existing sink ordering.
Passed on exact committed source.

uiVerification.summary: Real production execution routing and semantic Markdown render in isolated Chromium. Standard document/window return events baseline the currently committed background DOM immediately; no React same-content render is inserted before the next real public append. All four event orders reveal that append with a pending suffix and neighboring alpha wave, while the already visible prefix remains fully readable. Missing-all-event fallback deliberately retains one conservative current-content baseline. No native GUI, model request, installed dependency mutation or shared client build was performed.

acceptanceCriteria: Standard focus/visibility return events synchronously baseline current DOM only when a baseline is actually pending, the record is initialized and belongs to the same epoch, and its connected root is truly visible and focused.
The next genuinely new append after a standard return resumes character reveal without requiring an artificial same-text React commit.
Repeated focus and unrelated visible workspace events with skipNext false are no-ops and do not interrupt a current front edge.
Fresh/live/epoch permissions and reading quietUntil remain unchanged; background queue is cleared, old public text is not replayed and reasoning is excluded from the public baseline.
If all return events are missing, b949 live-focus fallback still baselines the first restored commit once before later appends recover; actual session unmount/reentry protections continue passing.
risks: The old native standard app-switch control already worked when the normal window focus event was delivered. This successor closes the b949 event-baseline boundary found by direct production-hook REDs; it does not claim native reproduction of missing OS focus events.

With no return events at all, the first subsequent render conservatively shows its complete current content; only later arrivals animate. Without an arrival-protocol change, the presentation layer cannot identify unseen source updates that have not yet committed to DOM.
The complete asset is not byte-identical across full frontend entry passes because unrelated existing sink insertion order changes. Protected reply regions, unique guards and final syntax are stable.

uiVerification.summary: Isolated real Chromium runs the patched production ResearchCanvas/workspace, React and actual HTML preview/content-size protocol. All four panels received content measures: 1574.375,1574.375,1574.375,2256.875 px, including two offscreen; no cell overlap, one standard arrangement, chat input focus preserved, done persisted only after geometry save. This is production frontend proof, not packaged-client/native acceptance. No shared client operation occurred.

acceptanceCriteria: Register the complete original panel membership only when a locally writable real applyWorkbench admits new nodes. Every original member must still exist, be completed and contain parsed component content; failed/cancelled/missing members cannot become success through a reduced count.

Persist the pending plan locally so generation while the canvas is unmounted or another session is visible can arrange once when this research canvas returns. Unregistered historical completed workbenches and remote collaborators do not get scanned into new ownership.

Use the exact manual Standard arrange implementation for the entire persisted canvas, including offscreen components. Its existing native settle and actual iframe content-size refit must finish and persist before consuming pending ownership. Late-mounted completed HTML panels recover active preview ownership and are measured too.

Auto arrange preserves current chat-input focus. Subsequent refresh, repeated completed plan hydration, undo, session switches and reopening do not repeat a consumed batch. A failed/interrupted save attempt cannot loop within the same mounted view; pending remains available for a later visit.

Retain the actual manual Standard/column selectors, undo, content-sizing and patch restore/reentry behavior; no version, public release, source push, new model/source call or shared build occurs in this feature worktree.
risks: The new auto-arrange ownership marker applies to plans newly admitted by this version. Old workbenches without this marker, including pre-update unfinished batches, are intentionally not adopted from history to avoid confusing a later ordinary refresh with a new generation.

If local storage rejects the pending/done marker, in-memory consumed/attempted state prevents same-process loops, but a later process can conservatively retry a previously persisted pending entry. Storage failure cannot provide cross-restart exactly-once durability; direct state and real core-persist-failure tests cover this boundary.

The pre-existing test 已有补丁客户端升级整理图标，不重复添加按钮或丢失回调 fails on its old SVG data-URI assumption both at unchanged bae8 baseline and this candidate. baseline-icon-check.json reproduces the null SVG match with the baseline serializer; this unrelated icon test was not changed or declared passed.
Packaged-client verification and real native acceptance remain with the root integration owner. The isolated production Chromium evidence does not assert model/tool/remote collaboration acceptance.
